# Ranzospace

> Ranzospace is an interior design and architecture studio in Mumbai, India, founded in 2018 by architect Manas Makwana. It designs and builds residential, commercial and hospitality spaces end to end: architecture, full-home interiors, custom furniture and decor, and design consultation. Every project passes 140 quality checks before handover.

Ranzospace works across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai. Enquiries are answered within 24 hours at info@ranzospace.in, on +91 96991 47145, or on WhatsApp. The only personal details collected are what visitors type into the enquiry forms (name, phone, email, project notes). They are used to reply and are never sold.

## Services
- [Interior Design](https://ranzospace.in/services/interior-design): Full-home and commercial interiors, planned as a unified whole, with 3D simulation, material specification, custom joinery and on-site execution included.
- [Architecture](https://ranzospace.in/services/architecture): Architecture and space planning from site study and concept to construction documents and site supervision.
- [Furniture & Decor](https://ranzospace.in/services/furniture): Modular furniture, wardrobes, kitchens and curated decor, sourced or custom fabricated, with delivery and installation.
- [Design Consultation](https://ranzospace.in/services/design-consultation): A site walk-through and focused session on direction, materials and budget, ending in a written report.
- [Services overview](https://ranzospace.in/services): All four services and what is included across them.
